prompt: Build a 2-qubit circuit that prepares the Bell state |Phi-> = (|00> - |11>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase — the SAME target as the standard Bell |Phi-> state. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H, Z, or any other gate directly — decompose them into this gate set (e.g. H can be built from RZ and SX).
